name: Sparkline
description: A tiny line or bar graphic that shows the shape of a trend, without axes. Decoration unless it has a label.

data.description: The values, oldest first. Non-numbers are ignored.

type.description: A line, a line with a soft area under it, or thin bars.

label.description: A text description, e.g. "Revenue, last 12 months: from 21K to 48K". Without it the graphic is hidden from assistive technology.

color.description: Color of the line or bars.

showLast.description: Marks the last point of a line with a dot.

showExtremes.description: Mark the highest and lowest points with small rings, so the range shows without reading numbers.

showAverage.description: Draw a dashed line at the average, to see which points sit above and below it.

requirements: With a label it is an image with that name; the label should state the range and direction, not just the topic
Without a label it is hidden from assistive technology: the surrounding text must already say what the number did
The shape is never the only way to get the information; put the figures in text nearby
Not interactive: no focus, no tooltip
screenReader: With a label: announced as an image, e.g. "Revenue, last 12 months: from 21K to 48K, image"

use_when: Showing the recent shape of a number inside a Stat, table row or sentence
Where space is too tight for a full chart
avoid_when: People need to read exact values: use a Chart or a Table
The trend is the main content of the page
anti_patterns: Leaving out the label when no nearby text describes the trend
Using it as the only source of the figures
Comparing sparklines drawn on different scales as if they were equal
